CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE CNR Number :KABC010342242022 Case Number :EX/0000002/2023 KRISHNAMURTHY G versus SATHISH M Date : 01-08-2024 Business : Case called out. Learned counsel for DHR filed IA.No.II U/o 26 rule 9 of CPC, seeking for appointment of court commissioner for the purpose perform ministerial act of this court. Heard. The learned counel for DHR urged that, in this case this court granted relief of specific performance of contract by passing judgment and decree in O.S.No.4555/2020 dated 02.07.2022. As per the said judgment and decree the JDR is requires to execute sale deed in favour of DHR petitioner within 3 months from the date judgment. The JDR fails to execute sale deed by receiving remaining balance sale consideration. Hence, prays for appointment of court commissioner for the purpose of execution of sale deed on behalf of JDR. I have perused the IA.No.I, petition and decree. In O.S.No.4555/2020 this court decreed the suit of the plaintiff and directed to defendant execute the sale deed by receiving sale consideration within 3 months from 02.07.2022. There is no record to show that, the judgement passed by this court is setaside or stayed by competant court of law. It is just and proper to appointment of court commissioner for performing minsterial act on behalf of this court. Hence, I proceed to pass the following:- ORDER IA.No.II filed U/o 26 rule 9 of CPC is hereby consider as filed U/o 26 rule 10-B of CPC and hereby allowed. One Advocate of Advocate’s Bar Bengaluru is appointed as court commissioner. The learned counsel for DHR filed memo with draft sale deed. Call on by 08.08.2024. Next Purpose : HEARING Next Hearing Date : 08-08-2024 CCH64 LXIII ADDL. CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE

--- NEXT ORDER ---

Thasildhar has been duly served, under which this court had sought the explanation to the salary drawing officer of the JDR herein for not attaching the salary of the JDR to satisfy the decree. The service of the show cause notice to the garnishee of the JDR has been reported to this court. Thus Spl. Thasildhar Yelahanka Taluk has fails to send his explanation and fails to appear before this court, thus this court felt, it is proper to call the Spl. Thasildhar to be present before this court. Accordingly ordered to issue notice to the Spl. Thasildhar Yelahanka Taluk Yelahanka, Bangalore to place his physicall appearance before this court on next date of hearing without fail. In this case, despite issuance of S/A/W to the garnishee of the JDR the same has not been carried out by the garnishee and despite service of show cause notice the garnishee remained absent. If that aspect is considered the garnishee may be hand in glow of the JDR, with intend to frustrate the decree of this court. Thus this court felt it is proper to order for issue arrest notice to the JDR. Heard the arguments of the L/c for the DHR on IA.No. 2. As the DHR made out the grounds that it is the JDR and his garnishee with intend to frustrate the decree are evading the process of this court, thus IA.No. 2 filed by the DHR is hereby allowed, ordered to issue arrest notice against the JDR, if the DHR pays the PF in the office. CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE CNR Number :KABC010007192023 Case Number :EX/0000104/2023 LAKSHMAMMA versus SPL LAO KIADB Date : 04-08-2023 Business : Statement of objection have been filed by JDR advocate. As per statement of objection cheque bearing no. 230962 dated 29.03.2014 of Rs.1,84,00,000/- pertaining to survey no. 215 of Bheemanakuppe Village has been numbered as LAC 57/2014 and the same day the JDR has sent another cheque bearing no.230963 dated 29.03.2014 for Rs.1,18,00,000/- pertaining to survey no. 205 of Bheemanakuppe Village, which was numbered as LAC 64/2014. It is stated that the office while registering the above cases with regard to amount in LAC 64/2014 have deposited the amount of Rs.1,84,00,000/- instead of Rs. 1,18,00,000/- and vice versa. The office while depositing the amount in LAC 57/2014 have deposited a sum of Rs.1,18,00,000/- instead of Rs.1,84,00,000/-. On perusal of both the records in LAC 57/2014 and 64/2014 it is seen that with regard to LAC 64/2014 the BDA has sent letter dated 09.04.2014 along with cheque no. 230962 for Rs.1,18,00,000/- but the office has taken cheque no. 230963 for Rs.1,84,00,000/-. On perusal of record in LAC 57/2014 it is seen that BDA has sent letter No.885/09-10 cheque no. 230963 for Rs.1,84,00,000/- but the office has taken cheque no. 230962 for Rs.1,18,00,000/-. There is mistake committed by the office in taking the cheques in LAC 57/2014 and LAC 64/2014. Hence, the amount deposited in respect of cheque no.230963 for Rs.1,84,00,000/- has to be transferred to LAC 57/2014 and the amount deposited in respect of cheque no. 230962 for Rs.1,18,00,000/- has to be transferred to LAC 64/2014. Copy of this order to be entered in LAC 57/2014 and LAC 64/2014 . Call on 22-08-2023. Next Purpose : NOTICE Next Hearing Date : 22-08-2023 CCH17 II ADDL. CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE

CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE CNR Number :KABC010007192023 Case Number :EX/0000104/2023 LAKSHMAMMA versus SPL LAO KIADB Date : 04-08-2023 Business : Statement of objection have been filed by JDR advocate. As per statement of objection cheque bearing no. 230962 dated 29.03.2014 of Rs.1,84,00,000/- pertaining to survey no. 215 of Bheemanakuppe Village has been numbered as LAC 57/2014 and the same day the JDR has sent another cheque bearing no.230963 dated 29.03.2014 for Rs.1,18,00,000/- pertaining to survey no. 205 of Bheemanakuppe Village, which was numbered as LAC 64/2014. It is stated that the office while registering the above cases with regard to amount in LAC 64/2014 have deposited the amount of Rs.1,84,00,000/- instead of Rs. 1,18,00,000/- and vice versa. The office while depositing the amount in LAC 57/2014 have deposited a sum of Rs.1,18,00,000/- instead of Rs.1,84,00,000/-. On perusal of both the records in LAC 57/2014 and 64/2014 it is seen that with regard to LAC 64/2014 the BDA has sent letter dated 09.04.2014 along with cheque no. 230962 for Rs.1,18,00,000/- but the office has taken cheque no. 230963 for Rs.1,84,00,000/-. On perusal of record in LAC 57/2014 it is seen that BDA has sent letter No.885/09-10 cheque no. 230963 for Rs.1,84,00,000/- but the office has taken cheque no. 230962 for Rs.1,18,00,000/-. There is mistake committed by the office in taking the cheques in LAC 57/2014 and LAC 64/2014. Hence, the amount deposited in respect of cheque no.230963 for Rs.1,84,00,000/- has to be transferred to LAC 57/2014 and the amount deposited in respect of cheque no. 230962 for Rs.1,18,00,000/- has to be transferred to LAC 64/2014. Copy of this order to be entered in LAC 57/2014 and LAC 64/2014 . Call on 22-08-2023. Next Purpose : NOTICE Next Hearing Date : 22-08-2023 CCH17 II ADDL. CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE

It is stated that the office while registering the above cases with regard to amount in LAC 64/2014 have deposited the amount of Rs.1,84,00,000/- instead of Rs. 1,18,00,000/- and vice versa. The office while depositing the amount in LAC 57/2014 have deposited a sum of Rs.1,18,00,000/- instead of Rs.1,84,00,000/-. On perusal of both the records in LAC 57/2014 and 64/2014 it is seen that with regard to LAC 64/2014 the BDA has sent letter dated 09.04.2014 along with cheque no. 230962 for Rs.1,18,00,000/- but the office has taken cheque no. 230963 for Rs.1,84,00,000/-. On perusal of record in LAC 57/2014 it is seen that BDA has sent letter No.885/09-10 cheque no. 230963 for Rs.1,84,00,000/- but the office has taken cheque no. 230962 for Rs.1,18,00,000/-. There is mistake committed by the office in taking the cheques in LAC 57/2014 and LAC 64/2014. Hence, the amount deposited in respect of cheque no.230963 for Rs.1,84,00,000/- has to be transferred to LAC 57/2014 and the amount deposited in respect of cheque no. 230962 for Rs.1,18,00,000/- has to be transferred to LAC 64/2014. No representation. The record reveals that the matter is of the year 2023 and cause notice to JDR by RPAD returned unserved as not claimed and the matter was posted for further steps by 15.04.2024 and on that day due to oversight without passing orders as to service of cause notice, attachment warrant of movables against JDR was ordered but it was not complied for want of PF and list of movables till 15.07.2024. Therefore, prima facie it appeared that the DHR is not participating effectively in the proceedings to get executed the decree. Therefore, the present petition is dismissed for default.
